name: Trackline
description: The issues of your Trackline account beside your work: on the canvas, in a chat and for your agents.

permissions.agents.start: Starts a chat on an issue when you ask
permissions.agents.tools: Lets your agents look up an issue
permissions.canvas.write: Puts an issue on the canvas and links its chat to it
permissions.chats.read: Shows which issues a chat is working on
permissions.clock: Checks your account for new issues every five minutes
permissions.hosts.provide: Shows the issues and changes of your account in the Issues panel and to your agents
